offline.title: No internet connection
offline.message: The point of sale needs an internet connection to look up products and record sales. Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Enter your email and password to continue.

sell.noPermission: Your account can't complete sales. Ask your manager.

search.label: Search for a product or scan a barcode

scanner.title: Scan a barcode
scanner.subtitle: Point the camera at the barcode on the tag.
scanner.hint: Hold the barcode inside the frame. The item is added as soon as it's read.

fault.insecureContext: The camera needs a secure (HTTPS) connection. Open this screen over a secure link, or type the barcode in instead.
fault.permission: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or type the barcode in instead.
fault.unavailable: The camera couldn't start on this device. Type the barcode into the search box instead.

picker.subtitle: Choose which one you're selling.

picker.numberNotFound: No such number, or it's sold out.
